posts.author: The Decoder
posts.text: Google's Gemini 4 Argon is closer to the AI frontier than any Google model in months. Google Deepmind's Gemini 4 Argon scored 97.5 percent on the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark, making Google the second lab after OpenAI to cross the 95 percent mark. But the results swing wildly depending on the test setup: in the standard harness, the score drops to just 49.8 percent. Argon also trails rivals in math and software engineering. posts.text: Introducing Reflection Beam: an open-weight model for agentic coding on AWS. Reflection AI's Beam is an open-weight model for agentic coding and long-horizon tasks. posts.text: 'Difficult to Overstate' Volatility of White House AI Messaging, Says Greg Allen.
